One way to create a prediction like this is to predict 1 whenever the probability is above ½ and to predict 0 otherwise. In this question, we will see that when logistic regression is used in this way, it is what is called a linear classifier — the feature vectors where it predicts 1 can be separated from those where it predicts 0 via a line. Linear classifiers are an important tool in machine learning.
a. Suppose we have fitted logistic regression to data using two covariates X1 and X2 and have a prediction that P(Y=1 | X1, X2) = L(β0_hat+β1_hatX1+β2_hatX2) where β0_hat=0, β1_hat=1 and β2_hat=2. Generate 1000 datapoints where X1 and X2 are both uniformly distributed between -1 and 1. Then, for each datapoint, using X1 as the horizontal axis and X2 as the vertical axis, plot it in blue if the predicted value P(Y=1 | X1, X2) is above ½ and plot it in black if the predicted value is below ½. To plot a collection of datapoints in a particular color, you can use the python code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.plot(x1,x2,’.’,color=’blue’)
where ‘blue’ can be replaced by ‘black’.
b. You may have noticed in (a) that a line separated the blue points from the black points. This is also true for generic fitted values of β0_hat, β1_hat and β2_hat: there is a line that separates the feature vectors whose predicted probability is above ½ from those that are below ½. The fourth edition of Jonathan Riley-Smith’s book, What Were the Crusades?, published by the Ignatius Press on March 23, 2009, is a self-described introduction to the crusading movements of the medieval period. The book primarily covers the First through Fifth Crusades to the Middle East, issued by the Catholic Church, with the primary objective being to take Jerusalem and its surrounding territories. It also covers the French crusades, also known as King Louis IX’s first and second crusades, respectively. It finely details the reasoning, justification, planning, and execution of the crusades, as well as the sociopolitical consequences of the crusades in Europe and the Middle East.
What makes Riley-Smith’s work exemplary among others is how he challenged the generally accepted definition of the crusades. He states in his preface for the third edition that the widely accepted yet baseless tenets of the field, prior to his studies, were as follows: “True” crusading was defined as attempts from Europe to gain control of Jerusalem; the crusaders’ opponents in the Middle East were culturally superior to them; most of them departed in hopes of gaining land, money, and political power; the military orders were religious orders in name only; and the Crusader states were a colonial experiment.
What Were the Crusades? serves as an academic rebuttal of these viewpoints, namely the first, third, and fourth points, as the second and fifth points were no longer considered worthy of serious discussion. Riley-Smith argues that crusading was not just limited to expeditions to the Middle East, but was done across Europe for centuries; the Crusades were in fact a religious war for the vast majority of those who took the cross; and the military orders were as much of a religious order as any other division of the church. These claims are presented not in tandem with but as a result of Riley-Smith’s goal of the book, which is to define the “who, what, where, and why” of the Crusades using concrete evidence rather than unfounded claims.
Naturally, Riley-Smith opens with a broad but satisfactory definition of the crusades — a series of religious and political expeditions aimed at reclaiming, defending, and conquering lands deemed important to Christianity. These military campaigns were usually initiated and supported by the Catholic Church, with the first crusade correctly taking place in 1095 by the decree of Pope Urban II.
Moreover, Riley-Smith counters the view that the Crusades were primarily motivated by a desire for personal gain, instead arguing that while there were certainly individuals who had materialistic motivations for joining, the majority of crusaders were driven primarily by religious devotion, namely the prospect of penitence. Asteraceae ditandai oleh kelopak bunga yang tersusun pada pusat yang berkembang secara sentripetal dalam kepala bunga, dikelilingi oleh bracts. Bunga-bunga tersebut biasanya memiliki mahkota berkelopak yang terdiri dari 5 buah, baik berbentuk aktinomorfik atau zigomorfik (ray). Bunga Asteraceae biasanya berlobus atau bergigi, dengan kelopak bunga yang berbentuk rambut, bulu, duri atau sisik, yang terdapat dalam satuan unit tersendiri atau tergabung. Asteraceae memiliki buah berkapsul tunggal yang disebut cypsela. Buah ini berkembang di ovarium inferior. lima benang sari dengan filamen biasanya bebas yang melekat pada dinding mahkota bunga, dan kepala sari yang biasanya menyatu menjadi sebuah tabung. Ada satu stilus, biasanya berbilah dua dengan rambut luar, yang dalam proses memanjang menggeser serbuk sari dari tabung kepala sari, sebelum memperluas dua lobus stilus linier di atas kepala sari. Famili Asteraceae juga memiliki metabolit sekunder yang khas dan beragam. Daun Asteraceae berbentuk alternate dan simple, terkadang majemuk (Dahlia, Artemisia) dan tidak terdapat stipula. Perbungaan Asteraceae berupa capitulum dengan reseptakel yang lebar yang berisi disc florets, ray florets atau kedua jenis bunga tersebut dalam satu perbungaan. Semua jenis Asteraceae memiliki bunga yang dikelilingi oleh daun kelopak (involucre bracts) dengan capitula yang disusun dalam bentuk globose. Bunga Asteracae terdapat dalam bentuk aktinomorfik (disc floret), zigomorfik (ray floret), dan epigynous. Asteraceae memiliki petal dengan lima kelopak, menyatu, berbentuk tabung dan berlobus lima (disc floret), sedangkan pada ligulat dengan 3-5 gigi. Pada Androecium, terdapat lima stamen dengan filamen bebas dan anther menyatu (syngenesious) membentuk tabung di sekitar stilus, epipetal, anter bithekaus, dehisensi longitudinal dan dua karpel yang menyatu pada gynoecium. Buah Asteraceae berupa cypsela yang memililiki pappus di ujung bijinya. In Italia sarà sempre ricordato per la speculazione contro la lira, un giochetto al ribasso che costrinse l'Italia a uscire dal Sistema monetario europeo nel settembre 1992 e allo stesso tempo gli fece intascare un profitto di mezzo miliardo di dollari. In quell'occasione George Soros spezzò la schiena anche alla Bank of England forzando l'uscita della sterlina dallo Sme, intascando un altro miliardo di dollari e diventando lo speculatore più ricco e famoso del mondo.
In America, sua patria di adozione dopo la fuga dalle persecuzioni naziste nella natia Budapest, Soros è noto invece per le sue posizioni polemiche e provocatorie di sinistra. «Darei via la mia intera fortuna per sconfiggere Goerge Bush», disse nel 2003, e donò decine di milioni di dollari ai candidati democratici. Soros ha preso anche posizioni iconoclaste a favore della decriminalizzazione delle droghe leggere e dell'eutanasia.
In veste di attivista filantropico George Soros è riuscito a lasciare un'impronta negli affari interni di nazioni in ogni angolo del pianeta. Nell'Europa dell'Est finanziò i movimenti dissidenti in Polonia, in Ungheria, in Cecoslovacchia e nell'Unione Sovietica a partire dal 1979; negli anni 70 pagò gli studi universitari dei neri in Sudafrica per combattere l'apartheid, poi aiutò i movimenti democratici in Zimbabwe. Dopo il crollo dell'Urss Soros ha finanziato programmi di democratizzazione in Russia e in altre nazioni dell'ex-blocco sovietico; è intervenuto durante il conflitto dei Balcani in aiuto delle popolazioni civili; ha investito 50 milioni di dollari in Africa per sradicare la povertà. Infine ha scritto numerosi libri di teoria economia e finanziaria per spiegare le bolle speculative e illustrare la propria filosofia di investimento.
Maestro dello sfruttamento a fine di lucro di queste bolle, il filantropo Soros col passare degli anni ha perso il mordente che aveva dimostrato quand'era un puro finanziere. Dopo la speculazione contro il baht thailandese che nel 1997 causò una crisi economica dagli alti costi sociali, Soros ebbe una crisi di coscienza. Di recente ha detto: «Nel business ho sempre fatto il mio interesse, ma da intellettuale ha perseguito l'interesse sociale. When using machine learning for power analysis attacks, the Hamming weight values output by the cryptographic algorithm SBOX are generally used as labels, and the unbalanced classification of the Hamming weight values output by SBOX leads to an imbalance in the data, which can cause lead to model learning bias. In 2020, DUAN used SMOTE for data augmentation to solve this problem. However, as this approach does not fully consider the distribution characteristics of adjacent samples, it may lead to greater repeatability issues between classes. Simon Limbres, jeune homme de vingt ans, est tombé dans un coma irréversible après un accident de voiture, il est hospitalisé en état de mort cérébrale. L'hôpital contacte alors sa mère, Marianne. 
Elle a dû crier fort, assez fort en tout cas pour que la petite réapparaisse, lente et grave, les yeux ronds, et vienne se figer à l'entrée de la chambre, la tête appuyée contre la chambranle de la porte, regard fixé sur sa mère qui ne la voit pas mais halète comme un chien, gestes précipités et visage tordu, pianote sur son portable pour appeler Sean qui ne décroche pas - décroche, décroche bordel -, sa mère qui enfile ses vêtements à la hâte, bottes chaudes, vaste manteau, écharpe, puis fonce dans la salle de bains pour s'asperger le visage d'eau froide, mais aucune crème, rien, quand, relevant la tête du lavabo, elle croise son regard dans le miroir - iris glacé sous les paupières gonflées, comme pochées par un coup, yeux Signoret, yeux Rampling, le rayon vert au ras des cils-, saisie alors de ne pas se reconnaître, comme si la défiguration avait commencé, comme si elle était déjà une autre femme: un pan de sa vie, un pan massif, encore chaud, compact, se A détache du présent pour chavirer dans un temps révolu, pour y chuter, pour disparaître. Elle discerne des éboulements, des glissements de terrain, des failles qui sectionnent le sol sous ses pieds: quelque chose se referme, quelque chose se place désormais hors d'atteinte - un morceau de falaise se sépare du plateau et s'effondre dans la mer, une presqu'île lentement s'arrache du continent et dérive vers le large, solitaire, la porte d'une caverne merveilleuse est soudain obstruée par un rocher - ; le passé a soudain grossi d'un coup, !S ogre bâfreur de vie, et le présent n'est qu'un seuil ultramince, une ligne au-delà de laquelle il n'y a plus rien de connu. La sonnerie du téléphone a fendu la continuité du temps, et devant le miroir où se fixe son image, les mains cramponnées au lavabo, Marianne se pétrifie sous le choc.
Saisissant son sac, elle s'était retournée et était tombée sur la petite qui n'avait pas bougé, oh Lou, l'enfant s'était laissé étreindre sans comprendre, mais tout en elle esquiva, mets tes chaussons, prends un pull, viens, et claquant la porte dans l'escalier, Marianne pensa soudain – une estafilade glacée – que, la prochaine fois qu'elle réintroduirait sa clé dans la serrure, elle saurait exactement, pour Simon. Un étage plus bas, Marianne sonna à la porte d'un appartement, recommença - dimanche matin, ça dort – puis une femme vint ouvrir, à qui Marianne murmura hôpital, accident, Simon, c'est grave, et l'autre, écarquillant les yeux, hocha la tête, souffla avec douceur on s'occupe de Lou, et la fillette en pyjama entra dans l'appartement, fit un petit signe de la main à sa mère par la porte entrouverte, mais soudain se ravisa, se précipita dans la cage d'escalier appelant : maman ! Alors Marianne remonta les marches en vitesse, s'agenouilla à hauteur de sa fille, la serra contre elle puis, l'ayant regardée au fond des yeux, lui répéta la litanie froide, Simon, surf, accident, je reviens, je reviens vite, l'enfant ne cilla pas, déposa un baiser sur le front de sa mère, entra chez les voisins.

Knowing how many civilians were injured during an earthquake is vital to allocate aids properly. Information about such victim counts is often only available within full-text event descriptions from newspapers and other reports. As a consequence, fine-grained counts of injured, displaced, or abused victims beyond fatalities are often not extracted and remain unseen. Igor (Svidersky) flares up. He always grapples with Georgy Akimovich.

Maybe better, I don't know about it. But we still don't have much of a chance. Only a miracle can save us. Otherwise, we will be crushed. Crushed by organization and tanks. A miracle?... Recently, soldiers were walking by at night. I was on duty by the phone and went out for a smoke. They walked and sang, quietly, in an undertone. I did not even see them, I only heard their steps on the asphalt and a quiet, even a little sad song about the Dnipro and cranes. I went. The fighters settled down to rest along the road, on the trampled grass, under the acacias. Cigarette lights flickered. And someone's young, soft voice came from somewhere under the trees. - No, Vasya... Don't say anything... You won't find anywhere better than ours. By God... Like oil, the earth is oily, real. - He even smacked his lips somehow in a special way. - And the bread will rise - it will close with your head ...
And the city was on fire, and red reflections jumped along the walls of the workshops, and somewhere very close, machine guns crackled now more often, now less often, and rockets took off, and ahead was the unknown and almost certain death.
I never saw the person who said it. Someone shouted, "Get ready to move!" Everyone stirred, their bowlers rattled. And let's go. We went with a slow, heavy soldier's step. They went to that unknown place, which on the map of their commander must be marked with a red cross. I stood still for a long time and listened to the steps of the soldiers moving away and then completely silent.
There are details that are remembered for a lifetime. And not only remembered. Small, as if insignificant, they eat into, somehow soak into you, begin to germinate, grow into something big, significant, absorb the whole essence of what is happening, become, as it were, a symbol. I remember one killed fighter. He lay on his back with his arms outstretched, a cigarette butt stuck to his lip. A small, still smoking cigarette butt. And it was the most terrible thing that I saw before and after the war. Worse than ruined cities, ripped open bellies, torn off arms and legs. Outstretched arms and a cigarette butt on the lip. A minute ago there was still life, thoughts, desires. Now is death.
But in that song, in those simple words about the earth, as fat as butter, about the bread covering you with your head, there was something ... I don’t even know what to call it. Tolstoy called this the latent warmth of patriotism. Perhaps this is the most correct definition. Perhaps this is the miracle that Georgy Akimovich is waiting for, a miracle stronger than German organization and tanks with black crosses. But yesterday, before my eyes, a shell exploded near him. Twenty steps, no more, burst. He just leaned over slightly and kept looking for the impulse. I wrapped the damaged area and then checked the entire wire in the area around the break.
That was a month and a half ago, in July. It's September now. We are already the tenth day at this plant. The tenth day the Germans bombed the city. They are bombing, which means that ours are still there. So there are fights. So there is a front. So it's better now than in July...

The narrative voice of A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man is remarkable for its limited yet fluid third-person narrative style, which is closely aligned to the consciousness of Stephen Dedalus. We never get to see inside other characters’ heads; instead, we see them the way Stephen does.. The subjectivity of first-person narration (in the form of a diary at the end) is combined with the objectivity of third-person narration, resulting in a narrative voice that is capable of conveying Stephen’s experiences and thoughts with an immediacy and an intimacy that, until then, had been rarely achieved in the bildungsroman form. Indeed, the book focuses so closely on Stephen, and takes us so deeply into his mind, that at times it resembles a first-person narrative. By doing so, the inner life of Stephen seeks to delineate in such a way that it does not merely serve the unfolding of the story but becomes the story. The narrator presents Stephen’s consciousness and activities in various ways; an important aspect about his narration is that he persistently adapts his style to Stephen’s idiom and mood

Saying, “Ever since I was parted from the reed-bed,
my lament, has caused man and woman to moan.
I want a bosom torn by severance,
that I may unfold the pain of love-desire.
Everyone who is left far from his source
wishes back the time when he was united with it.
In every company I uttered my grieving cry;
I consorted with the unhappy and with them that rejoice.
Every one became my friend from his own opinion;
none sought out my secrets from within me.
My secret is not far from my complaint,
but ear and eye lack the light.
Body is not veiled from soul, or soul from body,
yet none is permitted to see the soul.
This noise of the flute is fire, it is not wind:
whoever has not this fire, may he be nothing!
It is the fire of Love that is in the flute,
it is the fervour of Love that is in the wine.
The flute is the comrade of everyone who has been parted from a friend: its strains pierced our hearts.
Who ever saw a poison and antidote like the flute?
Who ever saw a sympathiser and a longing lover like the flute?
The flute tells of the Way full of blood

our days travel hand in hand with burning griefs.

The remedy of our pride and vainglory,
our Plato and our Galen!

if the mirror does not reflect, how is that?

第一段「3月21日，A股市场出现普遍反弹，三大股指全线上涨，创业板指涨幅近2%。北向资金净买入超42亿元，连续7个交易日实现净买入。机构买入力度回升，多只个股受到机构的大额买入。市场风险情绪好转，欧美银行股反弹。
从技术面来看，沪指站稳3000点关口，有望进一步向上探索；深成指突破13000点整数关口；创业板指重回2000点以上水平。市场量能有所放大，显示出多头的活跃程度。
从基本面来看，随着疫情防控形势持续向好，经济复苏的预期增强；政策面上，央行继续实施适度宽松的货币政策；行业方面，科技、医药、消费等板块表现较为抢眼。
总体而言，A股市场在经历了前期的调整后，在政策和基本面的支撑下出现了反弹的迹象。但是市场仍然存在一定的不确定性和波动性，需要投资者保持理性和谨慎的态度。」
第二段「今天a股的ai板块降温，整体跌了超过2%，也是本轮行情启动以来的第一次回调，多少还是引起了散户一定范围的恐慌。涨的时候焦虑上不了车，车倒回来了又会担心是不是要割自己，哈哈哈，炒股总是那么纠结。
目前是ai概念的早期，连openai都还没有明确的盈利图景，只是开了20美元/月的vip会员，估计也就勉强覆盖下运营成本。a股这些八杆子打不着的公司就更没谱了。所以短期内不用看基本面，决定价格起伏的只是情绪。
从市场节奏来看我不认为这波情绪炒作已经结束，更像是途中休整，后续可以再等等看下一波韭菜加入。但同时亦要有投机失败止损的计划，尤其是一些涨幅巨大的妖股，考虑设10%或者20%的止损线，我前几天回复读者时也说了，有“不赚钱绝对不卖股票”这类习惯的人不要冲热点。

.Japan uses the chaos in China to intervene on the Korean peninsula and unite Korea under the rule of the restored Korean People's Republic, initially founded by Lyuh Woon-hyung in 1945. . The Korean People's Army absorbs the Republic of Korea Armed Forces [ROKAF], and becomes the national militia and self-defence force of the restored Korean People's Republic. The Korean People's Army begins to work with the JSDF to restore order and stability to Korea as well as eliminate disloyal elements of the former South Korean army and government, yangaban descendants and survivors, Yi dynasty remnants and loyalists in the former Republic of Korea and Kim family loyalists, Juche loyalists and pro-Russian communists in the now defunct Democratic People's Republic of Korea from influence in the Korean political and cultural sphere. 

.The Japanese also use the opportunity to restore the Kingdom of Tungning ruled by the Zheng dynasty as its royal family and also reclaim Sahlakin Island, the Kurils and Palau as prefectures of the Japanese state. Manchukou and Mengjiang also return to being Japanese protectorates. Han Chinese settlers leave Manchukou, Mengjiang, East Turkestan and Tibet and the Manchus and Mongolians work with Japan to purge Manchukou and Mengjiang of Chinese influence and also to restore their cultural and civic pride. 

. The Japanese work with former IJA solider Lee-Teng-Hui and his pro-democracy movement to help reintegrate Taiwan into Japan and also purge Taiwan of pro mainland Chinese elements and KMT loyalists, with the remaining pro China supporters in Taiwan being deported to mainland China. 

. The CCP is defeated in mainland China and the People's Republic of China collapses due to the loss of key regions to successful independence movements and lack of international support. 

. The Empire of China created by 1915 is restored as the government of China with the House of Zhu which ruled the Ming dynasty being restored to its proper position as China's imperial family due to the covert intervention of Japan, which had sent the ROC government in exile on Taiwan back to mainland China in preparation for this event sometime after the end of the CCP and the fall of the PRC. The article “Physical activity and negative affective reactivity in daily life” investigates the role of physical activity in mitigating negative emotions emerging from daily life stressors. The authors discuss prevalent theories regarding the association between exercise and emotional regulation, including the Exposure Theory and the Cross-Stressor Adaptation Theory. The former suggests that physical activity inherently generates mild emotional stressors, therefore regular exposure to these stressors would enhance coping mechanisms against daily life stress. The latter posits that regular physical exercise enhances physiological stress adaptation which then translates to improved psychological stress tolerance.

The authors conducted an experimental study using participants who varied in age, gender, socioeconomic, and health status. They used ecological momentary assessment (EMA) and daily diaries to assess daily life stressors and negative mood, as well as accelerometer-based physical activity assessment. A total of 106 participants were involved in the study, which spanned 3 weeks.

Findings from the study revealed that daily physical activity was significantly associated with decreased negative affective reactivity to daily stressors, indicating that engaging in exercise moderated the influence of stress exposure on the onset of negative mood states. Furthermore, this association was consistent across age, education, income, and even health status.


The authors concluded that engaging in regular physical activity plays a crucial role in mitigating negative emotions resulting from daily life stressors. These findings provide support for both the Exposure Theory and the Cross-Stressor Adaptation Theory, underscoring the importance of exercise in maintaining emotional well-being.

This article, in alignment with my personal experience, emphasizes the importance of physical activity in managing stress and mitigating negative emotions. As I have personally experienced a noticeable decrease in negative emotional reactions after implementing regular exercise into my daily routine, the findings of this article resonate with me. Additionally, understanding the theoretical frameworks behind these findings helps me appreciate the dynamic way exercise benefits both physical and psychological well-being. It motivates me to continue including physical activity in my daily life and to encourage others to do the same to improve their emotional well-being.

Ove se brodice koriste u opasnim uvjetima i moraju biti čvrste i dizajnirane za izdržavanje dugotrajnog boravka na moru. U prošlosti su se brodice za spašavanje uglavnom gradile od drva, aluminija i čelika, ali su danas većinom izrađene od stakloplastike. Ovaj materijal je otporan na vanjske utjecaje poput kiše, vjetra i sunca.
Brodice za spašavanje dijele se na potpuno i djelomično zatvorene, a dostupni su različiti tipovi. Potpuno zatvorene brodice sastoje se od trupa, klupe i kabine. U izradi se koristi “sendvič tehnologija”, gdje se između dvaju slojeva postavlja izolator, najčešće poliuretanska pjena, koja povećava uzgon brodice. Pokrov i trup moraju biti vodootporni, a kapacitet neovisno o veličini je maksimalno 150 ljudi. Vrijeme ukrcaja u brodicu ograničeno je na tri minute, a brodica mora moći izdržati pad u more s visine od tri metra ili brzinu udarca od 3,5 m/s. Osim svega navedenog, brodica mora imati i motorni pogon te omogućiti sakupljanje kišnice. Brodice su numerirane rednim brojevima, pri čemu neparni brojevi idu na desnu stranu broda, a parni na lijevu stranu. Ukupna težina brodice ne smije preći 300 kg. Na teretnom brodu mora biti dovoljan broj brodica za ukrcaj svih osoba. Djelomično zatvorene brodice koriste se samo na putničkim brodovima, a kapacitet im je od 100 do 150 osoba. Ovakav tip brodice omogućava brži ukrcaj osoba zahvaljujući većem otvoru na pokrovu. Središnji dio brodice prekriven je pokrovom koji pruža zaštitu od elementarnih nepogoda. Postoji nekoliko načina za spuštanje brodice u more, a neki od njih su gravitacijska soha, slobodan pad i samo-oslobađanje. Ovi sustavi obično funkcioniraju pod utjecajem gravitacije i mogu se izvoditi sa zemlje, iz brodice ili s broda. Na slici 2 su prikazane zatvorene i djelomično zatvorene brodice za spašavanje. Važno je naglasiti da je ova vrsta opreme za spašavanje iznimno važna za ljudske živote u opasnim situacijama na moru i stoga se mora redovito održavati i provjeravati kako bi se osigurala njihova funkcionalnost i sigurnost. Osim toga, kako bi se osigurala sigurnost osoba u brodici za spašavanje, važno je da se pridržavaju određenih kriterija i standarda pri izradi i korištenju brodica. Kapetani brodova i osoblje za spašavanje moraju imati obuku u korištenju i održavanju brodica za spašavanje kako bi se osigurala brza i učinkovita reakcija u slučaju nesreće. 帮我改写一篇作文，题目是《我心雀跃》，使它能达到考试满分的水平，要求700字以上，900字以内，原文如下：

        汗水包围了我，浸泡了我的棉衣，使它变成吸水的海绵，像沉重的沙袋，阻碍着我前进，使我举步维艰。“调整一下呼吸，不要停。加油，到前面分叉口那里就可以先暂时休息了。”爸爸边跑边说，他语气平稳，也没有脚步声，与我是天壤之别。我腿脚麻到没有知觉，汗水覆满全身，胸口闷痛，喉咙中涌着血腥味，胳膊酸痛，完全放弃了爸爸教的“用鼻吸气口呼气”，只是用口急促喘气。我受我爸爸的话刺激，拼尽余力，狼狈地跑完了。爸爸拿纸巾给我擦去汗水，脱去了我的外衣，把他的衣服穿到我身上。“身体素质还是不行呢，不过有进步。下一趟会再跑慢一点，你要在跑的慢的时候调整好呼吸，找到适合自己的节奏。腿酸的话可以不用管，适应就好。”“好......”我一边大口大口地吸气一边答应。几分钟后，我爸爸又开始跑下一趟，我的噩梦又开始了。百花公园中，四处充满了人们的欢声笑语，鸟儿的愉快歌唱，我却被爸爸以要提高身体素质为由拉来跑步，真是煎熬。一想到今后还要继续下去，我心中下起了雨，泻下烦恼和不满。

This pattern continues, alternating the direction of traversal with each column, until the entire current array is covered.
